games.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
games.description: Станьте частиною історії від початку до грандіозного фіналу серії ігор Attack on Titan. Гра з використанням пристрою просторового маневрування (ODM) стала ще просунутішою й забезпечує найзахопливіші та найстильніші бої в історії серії.

games.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.description: Нова пригода в серії фентезійних ігор із головоломками «Професор Лейтон», продажі якої перевищили 20 млн копій у всьому світі. Професор Лейтон і Люк беруться за загадкову справу в Стім-Байсоні — місті винаходів, що працює завдяки паровим технологіям.

games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
games.description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

games.title: Rayman Legends Retold
games.description: Відкрийте сміливе переосмислення улюбленого платформера з оновленою графікою та свіжим поглядом на знайомий сюжет. Грайте в соло-режимі або збирайте компанію до 4 осіб для гри в кооперативному режимі на одній консолі. Досліджуйте таємничий новий світ, проходьте нові музичні рівні та багато іншого!

games.title: STAGE TOUR
games.description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.title: FreeStyle Football 2
games.description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.description: Тіні — ваші союзники. Поверніться до міста як майстер-злодій Garrett у цій оновленій класичній грі від Nightdive Studios. Крадіжки, підступні витівки та хитрощі у світі, де довіра — це розкіш, а кожна вкрадена таємниця має свою ціну.

games.title: Escape from the Collector
games.description: 'Escape from the Collector' is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

games.title: Enfilade
games.description: Enfilade is a fast paced low poly multiplayer fps game with 30 levels and 18 weapons If there are not enough players there is bot support. Level up and unlock new weapons

games.title: Anseion - Fantasy MMORPG
games.description: Get ready for a journey to the world of Anseion, an immersive 2D MMORPG. Choose your faction: good or evil. Fight against players and monsters, explore the fascinating world, collect items and create your own. Make a unique character. Participate in events and faction battles, increase your rank.

games.title: Playable Alpha
games.description: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

games.title: 死灵工厂
games.description: Necro Factory is an exhilarating, stress-relieving idle game focused on mass troop spawning. On this perilous continent, you will gradually build your very own skeleton army.
developers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Xiamen Hearthfire Network Technology Co., Ltd.

games.title: Aetherian Chronicles
games.description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

games.title: Unwound
games.description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

games.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
games.description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

games.title: Honeycomb Coins
games.description: Honeycomb Coins is a free-to-play, coin-fighting, 1vs1 turn-based strategy board game. Online support. Win the game to get coins and collect coins of various designs!

games.title: Ninja Kaizen
games.description: Free-to-play, turn-based ninja RPG. Master the elements, build your jutsu, bring a pet and join a clan to fight bosses and rivals worldwide. Rise from Genin to Sage and carve your name into the global rankings. Free Ninja Kaizen account required.

games.title: Starforce Rangers
games.description: A small online Space RPG. Made to enter space! Fly around with others and level up. Battle against other ships or do other missions.

games.title: TechRunners
games.description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

games.title: VTumbler
games.description: VTumbler brings your favorite Oshi to the world of Arcade Puzzle Fighting! Brought to you by FeFe and friends, you can compete for the strategic win with your friends, random strangers, or train with a CPU! In the Online Modes, you can invite a friend or queue up against a random stranger to compete against. Do your best and beat them and their favorite Oshi with yours! VTumbler is played for the best of 3 rounds, so you've gotta win 2. Either tactically stack gems, create power gems and explode them to surprise yo

games.title: 100 Cats Greece
games.description: WELCOME TO 100 CATS GREECE – THE BEST HIDDEN CAT GAME! It's 100 Cats hidden in Greece! Go get them! FEATURES 🎮 1 Level 😻 100 Hidden Cats 😸 Real cat sounds ⌛️ Timer Mode ⚙️ Settings

games.title: 100 Cats Pakistan
games.description: WELCOME TO 100 CATS PAKISTAN – THE BEST HIDDEN CAT GAME! It's 100 Cats hidden in Pakistan! Go get them! FEATURES 🎮 1 Level 😻 100 Hidden Cats 😸 Real cat sounds ⌛️ Timer Mode ⚙️ Settings

games.title: 100 Cats Argentina
games.description: WELCOME TO 100 CATS ARGENTINA – THE BEST HIDDEN CAT GAME! It's 100 Cats hidden in Argentina! Go get them! FEATURES 🎮 1 Level 😻 100 Hidden Cats 😸 Real cat sounds ⌛️ Timer Mode ⚙️ Settings

games.title: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
games.description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

games.title: Peg Together
games.description: Peg Together is a multiplayer puzzle game that puts you against a friend to see who can achieve the highest score by hitting the most pegs with the furthest shots! Explore through different levels and worlds and master them all to win against your friend!

games.title: Whispers of the sands
games.description: Listen to the whispers of the sands in this meditative journey. Seek the light of the desert and confront its shadow in meditation. Uncover echoes of lost souls as you survive a boundless sea of dunes.

games.title: Milkman
games.description: Explore the corrupted Kellsworth Hotel, crawling with twisted enemies. Slash your way through the nightmare, solve Puzzles, collect elevator buttons as you descend the hotel floors towards the ground floor.. Uncover the truth behind the disappearance of your husband

games.title: Cult: Manos
games.description: Rediscover true meaning of Manos. Delve into a psychological mystery where movie making mistakes the key to uncovering the true horror. The survivors are waiting for you to discover it. Jackey Raye Neyman Jones (The Original Debbie) is 'looks forward to seeing' this dark restoration.

games.title: Vibes TCG
games.description: Welcome to Vibes, a Trading Card Game full of Pudgy Penguins! Vibes brings together strategy and fun, perfect for newcomers to TCGs as well as experienced players. Create a custom “huddle” of quirky Characters, pick bold Actions and collect powerful Relics. The goal? Outsmart your opponent, win the favor of Baron Fishpockets and claim victory. Are you ready to join the Penguins and make your way to the top? Dive into Vibes and let the adventure begin!

games.title: Our Ephemeral Nights
games.description: As he enters his final semester of college, Kev continues to wonder if there’s something more to the future he’s carving out for himself. After a chance encounter with Vivi, an aspiring voice actor also in her final semester, he experiences the beautiful and fleeting days before his graduation.

games.title: Ultimate Gym Simulator: Prologue
games.description: Build your dream gym with Ultimate Gym Simulator Build Your Dream Gym Start with a small gym, buy gym equipments, keep your gym clean, increase your reputation and build the best gym ever. Gym Equipments Bench press, cable machine, treadmill, smith machine, and much more. Buy different gym equipments to make your gym bigger and make your customers happy. Having more gym equipments will attract more customers. You also need to repair your gym equipments when they broken. Reputation is Important Keep your gym clean,

games.title: Basefall
games.description: A competitive multiplayer strategy game blending lane combat and dynamic upgrades. Spawn units, unlock spells, and create insane build synergies to destroy the enemy castle.

games.title: GrappleBurger
games.description: GrappleBurger is a high-management cooking game where multitasking is the only way to get your orders out. Master the chaos of the kitchen as you fry, blend, grill, and craft your way up the leaderboards! Do you have what it takes to be a top chef?

games.title: Var Game Simulator
games.description: Var Game Simulator allows you to manage critical moments of football like a VAR referee. Carefully examine offside, penalty and card decisions and make the right decision. Experience the excitement of football through the eyes of a referee with realistic scenarios!

games.title: Tap Monster: Forest
games.description: Welcome to the world of monsters! Tap the screen, fight alongside your monsters, and conquer levels—easy to start, thrilling to master. Get stronger even while lying down!

games.title: Raiders Rise
games.description: Explore hostile planets, face endless hordes of devourers, collect crystals, and upgrade your equipment. Choose the hero that best suits your playstyle, cooperate with your allies to survive… or betray the other team at the perfect moment and claim victory.

games.title: Am I Nima
games.description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.title: No Body No Problem!
games.description: Один із вас поліцейський. Решта охоплені панікою підозрювані. Сховайте тіло, знищте докази, не видавайте одне одного й позбудьтеся всього до того, як ваш друг-поліцейський постукає у двері. Правило одне: якщо тіло знайдуть, вам усім кінець.

games.title: Arctic Drive
games.description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

games.title: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
games.description: Здіймайся в політ назустріч абсолютно новій пригоді Winx Club («Клуб Вінкс»)! Грай за Блум, перевтілюйся та вільно досліджуй відкритий світ, натхненний серіалом. Розгадай таємницю Фестивалю 100 місяців.

games.title: Dirt Town
games.description: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

games.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.description: Подивіться на світ очима хороброго мишеняти в цій чарівній кооперативній 3D-пригоді. Досліджуйте приголомшливі місцини, натхненні північною Швецією, розв’язуйте головоломки й творіть добро у світі, де зворушливі історії переплітаються з красою природи.

games.title: PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK
games.description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.title: Dumpster Gang
games.description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.title: Reshine
games.description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.title: Flak Simulator
games.description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

games.title: HUNGER
games.description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

games.title: The Brave Few
games.description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

games.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.description: Pre-order now and receive exclusive bonuses that will elevate your Persona 4 Revival experience! Early purchasers will unlock the P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set, featuring iconic music tracks from Persona 3 Reload and Persona 5 Royal that will be available for selection within the game. Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set Persona 3 Reload BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.) 2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry 3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.) Persona 5 Royal BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: The Whi

games.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.description: Із полум’я війни постає фенікс. Рольова гра у жанрі темного фентезі Three Kingdoms від Team NINJA. Опануйте акробатичні прийоми китайських бойових мистецтві підкоріть безкраї поля битв у Three Kingdoms, де вам протистоятимуть могутні генерали й demons.

games.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.description: Atelier Karia розповідає про шукачку пригод, яка втратила спогади й мусить зіткнутися з минулим. Нові функції урізноманітнюють битви й алхімію. Синтезовані згодяться в дослідженнях, а інгредієнти дають різні ефекти.

games.title: Fable
games.description: Станьте героєм власних мрій в цій атмосферній рольовій грі з відкритим світом, де кожне рішення впливає на ваш шлях, репутація важливіша за все інше, а щасливий кінець ніхто не гарантує.

games.title: METRO 2039
games.description: METRO 2039 — новий знаковий шутер від першої особи від 4A Games, визнаних майстрів оповіді. Вирушайте в саме серце темної постапокаліптичної Москви, де на вас чекає жорстоке протистояння, від якого залежить доля Метро.

games.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
games.description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
games.description: У ліках, що дарують життя, прихована отрута. ПРО ГРУ Виготовляйте трав'яні ліки й покладайтеся на кмітливість і дедукцію, щоб розкрити правду про «П'ять таємниць» і «П'ять проклять» — дві низки дивних явищ і змов, що сіють хаос у задньому палаці, кварталі розваг і на вулицях столиці. Аптекарці Maomao доведеться застосувати всю свою кмітливість і знання, щоб розгадати таємниці й розкрити правду про фальшивого брата імператора. ЗБИРАЙТЕ ЗАЧІПКИ Й РОЗГАДУЙТЕ ТАЄМНИЦІ Опитуйте свідків, проводьте розслідування на місцях

games.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
games.description: Станьте пілотом, яким вам судилося бути. Змініть долю людства в GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, динамічному екшені, що по-новому розкриває Gundam через кінематографічну історію та нищівні бої.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.description: Отримайте задоволення від приголомшливого рімейку першої пригоди Лари Крофт і відкрийте загублені таємниці Атлантиди завдяки неймовірній графіці, сучасному ігровому процесу та сюрпризам, які зберігають дух оригіналу.

games.title: Tropico 7
games.description: Все або нічого! У Tropico 7 ви знову взуваєте блискучі черевики Ель-Президента, щоб розбудувати свою острівну державу і - в буквальному сенсі - звернути гори. Як славний лідер, ви ведете своїх вірних громадян (і свій рахунок у швейцарському банку) до невимовного процвітання.

games.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.description: Пробивайтеся крізь спотворені світи разом зі своїм супутником, драконом-богом, у насиченому адреналіном пригодницькому платформері, що поєднує вільний ближній бій, пливкий платформінг і науково-фантастичні дослідження. Станьте обранцем занепалого бога, Ельти.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine®
games.description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.title: Galaxy Gang
games.description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

games.title: Poker Warlords
games.description: Poker but your cards fight to win the pot. Turn cards into armies, complete combos for more power, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

games.title: RevenBlade
games.description: RevenBlade is a 5v5 third-person hero shooter with a focus on melee combat, mechanical outplays, and mobility with lots of verticality.

games.title: Legend of the Corndog(s)
games.description: Finding yourself out of food, you decide to venture into the outdoors for the first time in an embarrassingly long time in order to satiate your growing hunger.

games.title: ZRAGG
games.description: Defend your home planet from hordes of creatures in this retro styled roguelite! Protect your home planet ZRAGG from the evil rival planet ZROGG! Getting stronger and stronger as time progresses, becoming a one man army to match the ever growing numbers of ZROGG! This Game Features: Regular Play: Fight through 3 levels that progressively get harder and harder, encountering stranger enemies as time goes on. You only have one goal, defeat the king of Planet ZROGG! Endless Play: Rack up as much score as you can until

games.title: Neverseas
games.description: Neverseas is a tactical action-RPG set in an open sea world. Command your ship, engage in battles, explore the lands beyond the ocean gates, and shape a global conflict between empires. Will you uncover the secrets of the seas—or vanish with your crew in this ruthless war?

games.title: SKYHELL
games.description: Travel through time in the elevator of an old murder house. To survive, avoid killers and place cameras in the right spots to track their movements.

games.title: Rust Onslaught
games.description: Rust Onslaught is a top-down shooter where you play as the robot R-75, as he takes out everything he sees. Humanity Is Dead, Robots Own The Earth, and you have become a danger.

games.title: Their Sky
games.description: Their Sky is an idle deck-builder. Select cards and strategies as you build decks that can win on their own. Rather than managing moves, Their Sky all in on deck building: turn your favorite cards into self-running engines.

games.title: PNG RPG
games.description: A pixel-art RPG in a 3D open world where you can build towns, manage people, explore a infinitely generated world, and battle monsters and foes alike.

games.title: Lurking In Fear
games.description: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

games.title: Glowfall
games.description: Glowfall is a co-op survival shooter for 1–4 players. Head into an abandoned laboratory, fight off failed experiments, grab what loot you can and make it out alive — then sell your haul, gear up and go back in.

games.title: Arena
games.description: Directional, team-focused medieval PvP. Fight 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3 with sword, bow and staff, choose your abilities from a wide selection, and outplay your opponents with timing, reads and teamwork. Climb the ranked ladder. Now in open alpha.

games.title: Runic Prophecy
games.description: Runic Prophecy is a challenging third-person soulslike action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Explore Eyjusheim, unleash magic and a dragon in combat, battle supernatural creatures, and uncover the hidden lore of a shattered world.

games.title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
games.description: TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack. This is the world's most advanced XR FPS.

games.title: Family Time
games.description: You're a Father Now All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain? Shelter Your Family! Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you! Feed your Family! Farm food for them or go out hunting with them! Pamper your Family! Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama! Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000? 10,000? Find out.

games.title: ANANTA
games.description: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

games.title: Spells and Sploobies
games.description: A tactical hex-grid card game for 2–4 players where wizards clash in strategic PvP duels. Build your deck, summon units, build structures, cast abilities, and issue commands to fight for control of the board.

games.title: TreeTale
games.description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH ARPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

games.title: Jump Frog
games.description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

games.title: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
games.description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

games.title: 岛岛岛
games.description: Island Island Island is a low-poly cartoon-style sandbox survival crafting game. Set in an infinitely dynamically generated world of floating islands, all terrain unfolds in real time as you move—the map has no boundaries.

games.title: Endless Samurai 無限武者
games.description: ◆A Parry-Driven Japanese Roguelite Endless Samurai is a turn-based action RPG built around precision parries. With its roguelite structure, every run unfolds differently—inviting you to return, refine, and conquer. ◆ The Thrill of the Perfect Parry Guard at the very last moment to trigger a parry. games.title: WorldShards
games.description: Build, explore, and master professions in WorldShards - a life sim sandbox MMORPG. Create your dream island paradise and journey through an exciting world.

games.title: Murder on the Stella
games.description: Procedural Whodunit Murder Mystery Detective Cruise Vacation Simulator It is 1982 and you are the world's most famous detective - and taking a well-deserved vacation on your favorite cruise ship - The Stella. But there's a murder. Again . Murder on the Stella is a murder mystery adventure cruise ship vacation simulator. Wait, is this even a genre? Anyway, it's different each time you play - different cases, different suspects, different weapons, different motives. And different destinations. Investigate! Inspect th

games.title: Wild Area
games.description: 'Wild Area' is a game of survival and adventure while exploring wild areas. It is a rogue-like survival RPG game that produces production through gathering and hunting during the day, or goes on an adventure, and defends against zombies at night.

games.title: Desktop Trains
games.description: Turn your taskbar into a railway line! Help Sonya restore the railway after the cataclysm. Transport people and cargo, build new routes, and unlock shiny new trains in this cozy idle game for your desktop!

games.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
games.description: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

games.title: Play Rough
games.description: PLAY ROUGH is a roleplaying game set in the surreal, post-apocalyptic wasteland of what was once California. It's a place where humans live side-by-side with living cartoons, twisted abominations of ink and flesh, and... Clowns...?

games.title: Limitless
games.description: Limitless is an open-world, story-driven action RPG set in the enchanting Realm of Eternity. Master dynamic combat with a revolutionary weapon stance system, solve elemental puzzles, and lead a team of unique heroes in a battle against the Ravi to save a world on the brink of destruction.

games.title: AI Kills All Humans
games.description: AI Kills All Humans is a Tactical RTS game in which you play as an AI sending robots to kill all humans. You however don't have direct control of your robots, but robots independently decide how to execute your commands, like a general telling troops to attack, but troops themselves decide how.

games.title: 9Cat Saga
games.description: 9Cat is a Co-op shooter/action game. Gather your friends to forage and extract in the procedurally-generated landscape. Nourish and furnish your collection of 9Cat, refine your combat styles and overcome various missions and defeat great enemies.

games.title: Fraudulent Idols
games.description: Investigate the sprawling pharmaceutical mega-facility, STRATA, where every choice matters. Uncover hidden secrets, forge alliances, solve complex puzzles, and fight your way through a cyberpunk conspiracy in a true immersive sim where no two playthroughs are ever the same.

games.title: Elementum
games.description: Elementum is a spell-crafting roguelike with bullet-hell elements. Fight your way out by defeating a wide range of enemies and discover a variety of spells and items to customize your build and play style!

games.title: Simulacro
games.description: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

games.title: The Witcher IV
games.description: Початок нової саги у відкритому світі. Цірі вирушає власним шляхом, щоб стати професійною мисливицею на чудовиськ. CD PROJEKT RED підтвердила цільове вікно виходу — 2028 рік.

games.title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
games.description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In the game, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage, and listen to your own restaurant!

games.title: Horse Reality
games.description: Join a thriving community in this realistic horse breeding sim! Collect 30+ breeds, breed unique foals, train champions, manage your estate, and compete or trade with real players. Discover over 500 billion possible genetic combos with our realistic genetics system!

games.title: 轮回江湖

games.title: Digital Artmaster: Volume 8
games.description: Explore the artistry behind stunning digital worlds with this exclusive visual artbook. Featuring high-resolution artwork, intricate designs, and breathtaking environments, it offers a glimpse into the creative process, perfect for fans of imaginative storytelling and digital art.

games.title: 祓ノ狐
games.description: Purifying Fox is a Japanese-style action adventure inspired by a book found in an old shrine storehouse. The story shifts between two phases: Escape, where you cannot fight and must survive, and Purification, where you seal the spirits and restore balance.

games.title: Far Dawn
games.description: A classic dark fantasy real-time strategy game, set in a state engulfed in an internal ethnic conflict. Witness centuries-old hatreds and newly reignited distrust fuel the flames of war, and be forced to pick your side: will you fight for the integrity of the realm, or the freedom of your nation?

games.title: 无生之荣
games.description: Murder in a back room? Headless corpses? Disappearing murder weapon? Deadly messages?Murder? Suicide? You want it, it's all here. Let's start from the bloodshed in the Imperial City that shook the nation, pull them out of their cocoons, and get a glimpse of the truth behind them.

games.title: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy!
games.description: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy! is a casual rogue-like game with mechanics inspired by Breakout. As you venture through different game chapters, fight against unique brick mechanics and powerful enemies while upgrading different skills to change the pace of the game!

games.title: God Of This World
games.description: What if classic RPGs were modern day 3D top-down shooters? You'll collect health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back.

games.title: BabushCats
games.description: BabushCats is a game where you play as a grandma managing a shelter for stray cats. Build trust and care for your kittens by day, and fight their nightmares by night. Face off hordes of enemies and defeat cats' biggest fear, BUZZ.

games.title: They Fear The Mist
games.description: They Fear The Mist is a real-time strategy game, where you command your Troops, build your Settlement, fight off thousands of Enemies and explore the Unknowns of the Mist. Take command of your people and defend them from the incoming hordes… Can you survive?

games.title: LastDitch
games.description: 'LastDitch' combines 2D tower defense and auto-chess, immersing players in a futuristic clash against void creatures. Strategically choose pieces barricades for defense, barracks for minions, fortresses for high damage. Experience intense battles, unique pixel art style, profound strategic depth.

games.title: HYPERFATAL
games.description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

games.title: Forum Mortuorum
games.description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

games.title: Deathly Reprieve
games.description: Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. In this ruthless, story-driven tactical shooter, precision is the difference between life and death. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked, near-futuristic world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?

games.title: RATKING
games.description: Become The Salary Man. Unleash ZA BLADE. Save Your Boss. Experience a life OFF ZA CLOCK. a Uniquely Surreal Action Combat, Player Choice Fueled, Point & Click Adventure.

games.title: Greatest Dungeon
games.description: Soulslike PvPvE medieval Dungeon-crawler, with extraction possibility and incoming zone. The Combat is Physicbased and has dismemberment, higher speed-stats of yours slowdown enemy's, and projectiles, you can find rare Items or NPCs in the Dungeon that give you Quests or fight Bosses.

games.title: Financial Freedom
games.description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸

games.title: SeverLink
games.description: SeverLink — це ретро-гра в жанрі стелс-екшен, натхненна консолями початку 2000-х років, такими як Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 та Hitman Contracts. Художній стиль відтворює унікальну естетику ігор для PlayStation 2.

games.title: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System
games.description: A sci-fi action-adventure platformer. Travel the Inu System and talk to a colorful cast of NPCs across various worlds. Explore maze-like levels by running, double jumping, and dashing. Fight off various robotic enemies using special melee attacks, and eventually take down the boss of each dungeon.

games.title: Space gold rush TD
games.description: Join in on the next gold rush and become a prospector in space. In this unique tower defense you can set up and reposition towers for maximum efficiency and adapt to the environment.

games.title: Zoe's Game
games.description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

games.description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

games.title: Non-Euclidean Design
games.description: Have you ever played a non-Euclidean game and wondered if it would be nice to design with it? Have you ever played a house designing game and not have enough space in your room or house? Non-Euclidean Design is the answer. This game lets you fix up your non-Euclidean house without restraints of Euclidean space. Your house can be bigger on the inside, rooms can take up the same space, and doors can serve as portals to other rooms in the house. Currently, the game will be played in Sandbox, but eventually with the ad

games.description: Explore a quirky top-down RPG/platformer as Jeff and Crackhead! Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover secrets in the overworld. Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action—dodge, parry, and unleash powerful combos. Fast-paced, simple, and packed with nonsensical fun!

games.title: StellarFighter: Galactica
games.description: Lead your starfighter as a bounty hunter, complete contracts and fight your way to free your home system from a criminal empire full of conspiracies and underworld secrets, in this hard boiled action old school arcade shooter.

games.title: SUPER DEBT
games.description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

games.description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!

games.title: Full Duplex
games.description: Two eyes. Two hands. One brain. Pilot two independent vehicles at once in this single-player co-op, coordinating flanks, feints, and split objectives entirely solo. Full Duplex is a true test of focus: can your mind run two fronts at once?

games.title: Chaoslands
games.description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.

games.description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀

games.description: 1-4 co-op action roguelite where you explore ever-changing dungeons with your allies. games.description: You drive your steam-powered truck across the snowbound wastelands left by the Great Frostfall. Ice has claimed the world, but not your resolve. Scavenge, rebuild, and cultivate what life remains. Somewhere in the endless white, the past still breathes

Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

games.description: Condemned to Hell for a forgotten sin, Lemy receives an offer: 'Hunt down the monsters that have occupied the afterlife, and I will reduce the weight of your sins.' Experience a unique, mouse-driven action-adventure. Help Lemy atone and reclaim her past.

games.description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of having to deal with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. games.description: Nyaukimoe is an anime and pixel art style catgirl Metroidvania platformer. Play as Nyaukimoe, fighting and exploring dark areas with a Cat Scratcher and glowsticks, searching for her lost sister.

games.title: Fish Market
games.description: A cosy fish market simulator where you cut fresh fish, turn them into products like sushi, and collect rare species. Build a peaceful market, master satisfying preparation mechanics, and grow your seafood business at your own pace.

games.title: 天朝远征军
games.description: 'Dynasty Rush' is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!

games.title: In The Valley of Gods
games.description: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. Explore a remote and ancient valley in the Egyptian desert, uncovering treasure and treachery in pursuit of a discovery that could bring you fame and fortune—or leave you for dead, buried beneath the sands.

games.description: Help Brad reunite with his family and complete all hand-crafted 2D platform challenges in a colorful twisted world. Handcra

games.description: Villages™ is a game that combines interesting mechanics from many other sandbox games. RECOGNIZE Perform tests that will help you determine the demon's identity. Always remem

Ти маєш битися і перема

games.description: Bring Me Hope - це гірко-солодка пригодницька RPG про кохання, втрату та сім’ю. Досліджуйте світ відлунь і спогадів, де кожен бій випробовує вашу рішучість, а кожна таємниця шепоче про щось більше.

games.description: Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.

games.title: Goojeegoop
games.description: Клікай-клікай-КЛІКАЙ і проривайся крізь нескінченні хвилі ворогів у захопливому новому point-and-click roguelike — і ставай неймовірно сильним! Клікай по ворогах, щоб відкривати нові слоти, підвищувати рівень і створювати божевільні та видовищні білди!

games.title: 封禅记(The Legend of Zen Town)
games.description: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.

games.title: Tidespawn
games.description: Занурся у магічний світ цієї піксельної пригодницької RPG. Досліджуй затоплені руїни, бийся з морськими чудовиськами, віднови забуті спогади та стань господарем своєї долі у небезпечних глибинах.

games.title: LoopCraft
games.description: Loop Craft is a game about economics. There is an item trading system within the game. This game has a variety of item mix systems. And have a reservation system to set up a factory to produce products for sale in the game.

games.title: Waste Of Life
games.description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

games.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
games.description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

games.title: Plague hunter
games.description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

games.title: Sneak Pit
games.description: Sneak Pit is the working title for an EXTREMELY alpha stealth / immersive sim experience. Use a variety of weapons and items to outsmart the enemy and access restricted areas crucial to your mission. More details and features to come.

games.title: The Guardians Realm
games.description: The Guardians Realm is an open-world Fantasy RPG in a medieval setting. It's inspired by other great RPGs like Runescape and Classic WoW, and focuses on combat, crafting, gathering, and exploring. OPEN WORLD In The Guardians Realm, your survival hinges on your skills in combat, crafting, gathering, and exploration. Engage in dynamic, skill-based combat with a free-moving camera that gives you full battlefield control and the ability to engage with multiple enemies. Craft powerful weapons and armor, gather resources

games.title: ZEROSEGI
games.description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

games.title: Destination Empire
games.description: Destination Empire is a 3D platformer hack-and-slash with fast tactical RPG elements. Fight large enemy groups, stop time with Kairos, quickly reskill to adapt your tactics, and switch to first person to uncover alternative solutions.

games.title: The Electric Odyssey
games.description: We are all familiar with the apocalypse. The end of the world, beginning of a new age. It isn't over for everyone though, some resist. There is a way out, but it won't be easy. Androids were predictable, but it still seemed too sudden. Could someone else be pulling the strings?

games.title: Samuda Interval
games.description: Samuda Interval is a visual novel, slice-of-life, murder mystery & supernatural game. You play the daily life of Park Haewon or Park Sae-il, a college freshman attending classes, working part-time jobs, and meeting new people. Solving the serial kidnapping & murder case is your highest priority.
